notes: IDENTITY LIKELY A COMPOSITE (research 2026-07-03, unresolved): the birthplace "Wales, Massachusetts" is almost certainly a conflation error — there is a well-documented immigrant Thomas Merrick (c.1620-1704) born in Wales (St. David's Parish, Pembrokeshire) who settled in Springfield, MA (WikiTree Merrick-10; Familypedia), i.e. country-of-origin and place-of-settlement merged into one field. But that documented Thomas Merrick married Elizabeth Tilley and died 1704 in Springfield, not Mary Griggs / 1684 Middletown, CT as this record has it. A search for "Mary Griggs" + Middletown, CT instead surfaced an unrelated couple, Thomas Stow (1615-1684) m. Mary Griggs, of Roxbury/Concord/Middletown — suggesting this record may itself mix two or more distinct colonial families with overlapping given names and Connecticut River Valley geography. Treat as unresolved rather than a single documented person.
